title: Very thin material
text: Very thin material. Mine was broken in shipping. The plastic was very thin and brittle, I would have been disappointed even if it hadn’t been broken. My old one was sturdier, so I just used the suction cups from this on on the old one. They do stick very well.

product_metadata.title: iDesign Plastic Sponge Holder Suction Cups Ideal for Kitchen Sinks and Bathroom Organization, 6.5" x 2.5" x 2.5", Clear
features: KITCHEN SPONGE HOLDER –The iDesign Dish Sponge Holder and kitchen sink caddy keeps cleaning supplies such as bar soap, sponges, scrub brushes, and more off the countertop and within reach; it's also great for organizing the bathroom

OPEN DESIGN WITH SUCTION CUP ADHESION – This kitchen sink organizer features an open design that allows items to dry more efficiently after use, while the included suction cups maintain a secure hold in wet or dry conditions

EASY INSTALLATION – To install the kitchen sponge holder for sinks, push the suction cups into place for a powerful hold on most smooth surfaces including glass, tile, fiberglass & some metals; clean surface with alcohol & let dry before applying for optimal adhesion
DURABLE - Crafted from a strong plastic construction, the sink sponge holder is designed to withstand years of use
EFFICIENT STYLE – Measures 6.5" x 2.5" x 2.5" and creates instant kitchen sink organization in compact spaces
description: Organize your sink with the iDesign Plastic Sponge Holder for Kitchen Sink with Suction Cups. The kitchen sink caddy keeps cleaning supplies such as bar soap, sponges, scrub brushes, and more off the countertop and within reach; it's also great for organizing the bathroom. This kitchen sink organizer features an open design that allows items to dry more efficiently after use, while the included suction cups maintain a secure hold in wet or dry conditions. To install the kitchen caddy, push the suction cups into place for a powerful hold on most smooth surfaces including glass, tile, fiberglass & some metals; clean surface with alcohol & let dry before applying for optimal adhesion. Crafted from a strong plastic construction, the sink sponge caddy is designed to withstand years of use. Measures 6.5" x 2.5" x 2.5" and creates instant kitchen sink organization in compact spaces.With iDesign, you can live simply and sustainably every day.

This attractive and sturdy sinkware is large enough to hold a couple of your frequently used kitchen scrubbers and sponges, but has a narrow profile that keeps it out of the way. The tray is well ventilated on the bottom and front, so your scrubbers air-dry quickly to stay fresh. Two suction cups hold the tray solidly in place on any smooth surface, including tile, steel, or glass. It also sticks tight to shower walls for use as a bathroom organizer.
